rows.question: What is the Coverage B limit for detached structures like a fence or shed?
rows.answer: We cover other structures on the residence premises that are set apart from the dwelling by clear space, such as a detached garage, fence or garden shed. [ho-property-coverages#coverage-b-other-structures-0] The Coverage B limit is 10 percent of the Coverage A limit unless a higher limit is shown on the declarations. [ho-property-coverages#coverage-b-other-structures-0] Property usually located at a secondary residence is limited to 10 percent of the Coverage C limit. [ho-property-coverages#coverage-c-personal-property-0]

rows.question: How much does the policy pay for theft of jewelry and watches?
rows.answer: The following special limits apply per loss: 200 dollars for cash and coins; 1,500 dollars for securities and passports; 1,500 dollars for watercraft including trailers; 2,500 dollars for theft of jewelry, watches and furs; 2,500 dollars for theft of firearms; and 2,500 dollars for business property on the residence premises. [ho-property-coverages#special-limits-of-liability-0] The insured recently increased Coverage C limits or added scheduled jewelry shortly before a theft. [fraud-red-flags#policy-red-flags-0]

rows.question: Is sewer or drain backup covered, or is it excluded with flood?
rows.answer: First establish whether the water was a sudden and accidental discharge, which is covered, or flood, surface water, sewer backup or long-term seepage, which are excluded unless an endorsement applies. [claims-water-damage-sop#coverage-determination-0] Water that backs up through sewers or drains is also excluded unless the Water Backup endorsement NM-END-14 is attached. [ho-perils-exclusions#exclusion-flood-0]

rows.question: Does the policy cover earthquake or sinkhole damage?
rows.answer: We do not cover earthquake, landslide, mudflow, sinkhole or other earth sinking, rising or shifting. [ho-perils-exclusions#exclusion-earth-movement-0] If earth movement results in a fire or explosion, we do cover the resulting fire or explosion damage. [ho-perils-exclusions#exclusion-earth-movement-0] "Occurrence" means an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same harmful conditions, that results in bodily injury or property damage during the policy period. [ho-definitions#occurrence-0]

rows.question: When is a dwelling loss settled at replacement cost versus actual cash value under the 80 percent rule?
rows.answer: Covered losses to the dwelling are settled at replacement cost if, at the time of loss, the Coverage A limit is at least 80 percent of the full replacement cost of the dwelling. [ho-conditions#loss-settlement-0] If the limit is below 80 percent, we pay the larger of the actual cash value or a proportion of the replacement cost. [ho-conditions#loss-settlement-0] Personal property is settled at actual cash value unless the Personal Property Replacement Cost endorsement is attached. [ho-conditions#loss-settlement-0]

rows.question: How does the appraisal process work when we disagree on the amount of loss?
rows.answer: If you and we fail to agree on the amount of loss, either party may demand an appraisal. [ho-conditions#appraisal-0] An agreement signed by any two of the three sets the amount of loss. [ho-conditions#appraisal-0] Verify the policy was in force on the date of loss and the loss location matches the insured location. [claims-fnol-sop#intake-steps-0]

rows.question: What is the per person limit for medical payments to others?
rows.answer: We pay necessary medical expenses incurred within three years from the date of an accident causing bodily injury to others. [ho-liability#coverage-f-medical-payments-to-others-0] Coverage F applies regardless of fault, up to 5,000 dollars per person. [ho-liability#coverage-f-medical-payments-to-others-0] Our duty to defend ends when the limit of liability has been exhausted by payment of judgments or settlements. [ho-liability#coverage-e-personal-liability-0]

rows.question: Are roofs with asphalt shingles older than 20 years eligible for new business?
rows.answer: Roofs with asphalt shingles older than 20 years are ineligible for new business unless an inspection confirms at least five years of remaining life. [uw-homeowners-guideline#roof-age-and-condition-0]

rows.question: What windstorm deductible is required for risks near tidal water?
rows.answer: Risks within 1,000 feet of tidal water require a minimum 2 percent windstorm deductible. [uw-homeowners-guideline#coastal-and-wildfire-zones-0]

rows.question: What Coverage A limit can a senior underwriter bind without manager approval?
rows.answer: Associate underwriters may bind Coverage A limits up to 750,000 dollars. [uw-referral-authority#authority-levels-0] Senior underwriters may bind up to 1,500,000 dollars. [uw-referral-authority#authority-levels-0] Coverage A limits above 1,500,000 dollars require approval from the regional underwriting manager. [uw-referral-authority#authority-levels-0]

rows.question: How quickly must the adjuster make first contact with the insured after FNOL?
rows.answer: The assigned adjuster must make first contact with the insured within 24 hours of FNOL. [claims-fnol-sop#contact-standards-0]

rows.question: When do initial reserves need supervisor approval?
rows.answer: Set the initial indemnity reserve using the reserve worksheet for the cause of loss. [claims-fnol-sop#initial-reserves-0] Reserves above 100,000 dollars require supervisor approval. [claims-fnol-sop#initial-reserves-0]

rows.question: What mitigation invoice amount can a vendor bill without adjuster sign-off for water damage?
rows.answer: Approved mitigation vendors may be dispatched without prior approval for invoices up to 5,000 dollars. [claims-water-damage-sop#emergency-mitigation-0] Mitigation costs above 5,000 dollars need adjuster sign-off before work continues. [claims-water-damage-sop#emergency-mitigation-0] Mitigation vendors must provide daily moisture readings, photographs and a drying log. [claims-water-damage-sop#moisture-documentation-0]

rows.question: How many red flags should trigger a referral to the Special Investigations Unit?
rows.answer: When three or more red flags are present, or any single high-severity flag, refer the claim to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) within five business days. [fraud-red-flags#how-to-use-this-checklist-0]

rows.question: How is actual cash value defined, including depreciation?
rows.answer: "Actual cash value" means the cost to replace damaged property with new property of like kind and quality, minus depreciation for age, condition and obsolescence. [ho-definitions#actual-cash-value-0] If the limit is below 80 percent, we pay the larger of the actual cash value or a proportion of the replacement cost. [ho-conditions#loss-settlement-0] Until repair or replacement is complete, we pay no more than actual cash value. [ho-conditions#loss-settlement-0]
